 [SBS 8 News] 
 In tonight's SBS 8 News, 
 ▶ Ministerial nominee Lee Yong-cheol says he "knows little about Daejang-dong," pushes back against opposition offensive labeling him the "hidden designer" 
 ▶ Trump offers White House press secretary position to UFC CEO, vows retaliatory investigations against Democrats 
 ▶ Indiscriminate shooting at Polish tourist spot leaves at least 6 dead and 16 injured 
 ▶ Earthquake up to magnitude 5.7 strikes Shizuoka Prefecture and other areas in Japan; authorities warn of "major earthquakes over the next 2 to 3 days" 
 ▶ Samsung Lions reclaim Korean Series championship after 12 years; Koo Ja-wook named MVP 
 ▶ An Se-young claims Korea Open title with 55th consecutive win, achieving an unprecedented second straight year with 11 tournament victories 
 ▶ Jensen Huang's eldest daughter abruptly cancels trip to Korea; is it due to her father's alleged ties to a "Chinese spy"? 
 We bring you detailed reports on these stories and more.
